audit_status.source_base: Greek Ephesians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for children/parents, enslaved/masters with safeguard, armor as spiritual resilience, prayer, Tychicus, peace/grace.

verses.restored: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is righteous/just.

familiar.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

modern.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

original.text: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον·

verses.restored: Honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with promise,

familiar.text: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;

modern.text: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),

original.text: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ,

verses.restored: so that it may be well with you and you may be long-lived upon the earth.

familiar.text: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

modern.text: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”

original.text: ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.restored: And fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but nourish them in discipline and instruction of the Lord.

familiar.text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

modern.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord. Serving with Honor (Colossians 3:22–25; 1 Timothy 6:1–2)

original.text: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες, μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ κυρίου.

verses.restored: Enslaved ones, obey the earthly masters with fear/reverence and trembling, in sincerity of your heart, as to Messiah,

familiar.text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

modern.text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.

original.text: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε τοῖς ⸂κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις⸃ μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ,

verses.restored: not according to eye-service as people-pleasers, but as enslaved ones of Messiah, doing the will of the Divine from the soul/life,

familiar.text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

modern.text: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.

original.text: μὴ κατʼ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλʼ ὡς ⸀δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐκ ψυχῆς

verses.restored: serving with goodwill as to the Lord and not to humans,

familiar.text: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

modern.text: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,

original.text: μετʼ εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,

verses.restored: knowing that whatever good each does, this one will receive back from the Lord, whether enslaved or free.

familiar.text: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

modern.text: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.

original.text: εἰδότες ὅτι ⸂ἕκαστος, ὃ ἂν⸃ ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν, τοῦτο ⸀κομίσεται ⸀παρὰ κυρίου, εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος.

verses.restored: And masters, do the same things toward them, giving up threatening, knowing that both their Master and yours is in heavens, and partiality is not with him.

familiar.text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

modern.text: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him. The Full Armor of God

original.text: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι, τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ⸂αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν⸃ ὁ κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρʼ αὐτῷ.

verses.restored: Finally, be empowered in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

familiar.text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

modern.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

original.text: ⸂Τοῦ λοιποῦ⸃ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Put on the full armor of the Divine, so that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the adversarial one.

familiar.text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

modern.text: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.

original.text: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι ὑμᾶς στῆναι πρὸς τὰς μεθοδείας τοῦ διαβόλου·

verses.restored: Because our wrestling is not against blood and flesh, but against rulers, against authorities, against cosmic powers of this darkness, against spiritual forces of harmfulness in the heavenlies.

familiar.text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

modern.text: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

original.text: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς, πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας, πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ ⸀σκότους τούτου, πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις.

verses.restored: Because of this take up the full armor of the Divine, so that you may be able to withstand in the harmful day, and having worked all things, to stand.

familiar.text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

modern.text: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.

original.text: διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι.

verses.restored: Stand therefore, having girded your waist with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness/justice,

familiar.text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

modern.text: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,

original.text: στῆτε οὖν περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ὑμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης,

verses.restored: and having bound sandals under your feet in readiness of the good news of peace.

familiar.text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

modern.text: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.

original.text: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης,

verses.restored: In all things taking up the shield of trust, with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the harmful one.

familiar.text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

modern.text: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

original.text: ⸀ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως, ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ ⸀πονηροῦ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι·

verses.restored: And receive the helmet of salvation/healing, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of the Divine,

familiar.text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

modern.text: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

original.text: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου ⸀δέξασθε, καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα θεοῦ,

verses.restored: through every prayer and petition, praying in every season in Spirit, and into this keeping alert in all perseverance and petition concerning all the holy ones,

familiar.text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

modern.text: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.

original.text: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως, προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν πνεύματι, καὶ εἰς ⸀αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων,

verses.restored: and for me, that word may be given to me in opening my mouth, in boldness to make known the mystery of the good news,

familiar.text: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

modern.text: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,

original.text: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα μοι δοθῇ λόγος ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ στόματός μου, ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου

verses.restored: for which I am an ambassador in chain, so that in it I may speak boldly as it is necessary for me to speak.

familiar.text: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

modern.text: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should. Final Greetings (Philippians 4:21–23; 2 Timothy 4:19–22)

original.text: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

verses.restored: But so that you also may know the things concerning me, what I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved sibling and trustworthy servant in the Lord, will make everything known to you,

familiar.text: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

modern.text: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.

original.text: Ἵνα δὲ ⸂εἰδῆτε καὶ ὑμεῖς⸃ τὰ κατʼ ἐμέ, τί πράσσω, πάντα ⸂γνωρίσει ὑμῖν⸃ Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν κυρίῳ,

verses.restored: whom I sent to you for this very thing, so that you may know the things concerning us and he may comfort/encourage your hearts.

familiar.text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

modern.text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.

original.text: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.

verses.restored: Peace to the siblings, and love with trust, from Divine Father and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: Grace with all those loving our Lord Jesus Messiah in incorruptibility.

familiar.text: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

modern.text: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.

original.text: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ⸀ἀφθαρσίᾳ.

safety_note: Ephesians 6 must not be used to sanctify slavery, coercive parenting, or domination. The text is preserved as ancient household instruction, while verse 9 relativizes master power under the heavenly Lord and commands giving up threats. Armor imagery is spiritual resilience against harmful powers, not violence against people.
